name: smollm2-360m-godot-micro-brain
purpose: Tiny local CPU micro-brain for high-frequency Godot micro-actions: intent classification, tool selection, compact action JSON, file/scene organization and escalation decisions.
training_strategy: LoRA/SFT on verified Godot tool-use micro-tasks and distilled research evidence. No pretraining or full-weight training.
vision_policy: Vision/video are handled by a multimodal provider. The micro-brain receives structured intent and selects the next small Godot action.
